eligibility.evidence: Sections 1-4: instruction-tuned Qwen2 and Gemma 2 models are tested on in-context Boolean/numerical concept learning modelled on Feldman (2000) human Boolean concept learning; accuracy is analysed against concept complexity (Table 2, Figure 1).

A.title: Minimization of Boolean Complexity in In-Context Concept Learning

E.headline: LLM in-context concept learning shows a simplicity bias like that reported for humans: accuracy falls as Boolean complexity of the concept rises.

G.notes: Human comparison is purely by citation to Feldman (2000); no human data or magnitude comparison. Only 5 complexity-class means per model enter each correlation; one prompt template (stated limitation). Qwen2-72B correlation not significant.
